title: A long text about search
text: Search is old. Library catalogs searched cards, and early engines searched words in documents. Each engine kept a list of documents for each word, and each query read the lists of its words. Then the engine scored each document and ranked the documents by score. BM25 is one such score: it counts each word of the query in the document, weights rare words more, and divides by the length of the document, so that a long document does not win only by its length.
